name: Weekly Compliance Audit
description: Weekly audit of the fleet: password policy, installed patches, USB/media policy, and inventory drift, with a report for the security team.

error_handler.title: Inventory collection failed
error_handler.body: Could not collect inventory from one or more devices

error_handler.title: Password policy drift
error_handler.body: One or more devices are out of compliance with the password policy

error_handler.title: Patch drift detected
error_handler.body: One or more devices are missing required security patches

error_handler.title: Media policy violations
error_handler.body: USB/media policy violations found on one or more devices

config.title: Weekly compliance audit complete
config.body: Audit report generated. Review findings in the compliance dashboard.
